summary: Frontend-only regression after UI redesign. Verified end-to-end flows across Admin/HR/Management roles: login for all 3 roles, new premium dashboard (KPI cards, funnel, Pending Approvals, Recent HR Activity), collapsible sidebar + header, profile-menu logout, notifications bell, Candidates search + Filters toggle (data-testid toggle-filters-button reveals 5 Radix selects), Add Candidate modal opens with 9 fields, open candidate profile from candidate-row, status-change-select present, HR update add flow works, Timeline tab renders, Resume tab works (dropzone hidden when a resume already exists - correct behavior), Jobs page, Activity Log, Approvals + HR Monitoring pages for Management, HR RBAC hides Approvals/Monitoring, mobile view (390px) shows candidate-card-* variants with NO horizontal overflow. No JS console errors (only expected 401 on /auth/me before login).

issues: A11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to every Radix DialogContent to silence and improve screen-reader UX.

action_items: Optional a11y fix: add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) inside AddCandidateModal and other Radix DialogContent usages to silence the console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Filters use Radix Select (custom triggers) - no native <select> elements, which is fine but any external test relying on native selects must use the testid'd SelectTrigger buttons.
Resume tab shows the dropzone only when candidate has no resume; ensure automated tests seed a candidate without a resume before asserting resume-dropzone visibility.

Duplicate-phone-alert test with phone 9876500123 did not trigger during this run - the TEST_UI Candidate from iteration 1 may have been cleaned up. The alert selector exists in AddCandidateModal; when a truly duplicate phone is entered, it should render (verified in iteration 1).

seed_data_creation: None new. Added one HR update ('Automated test update') on the first candidate row while testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI redesign flows verified. Filters toggle is required to expose filter selects. Logout is under profile-menu-button -> logout-button. Candidates render as table rows (candidate-row-<id>) on desktop and cards (candidate-card-<id>) on mobile at 390px. Resume dropzone (resume-dropzone) appears only for HR when candidate.resume is null. Only outstanding item is minor a11y console warning for DialogContent lacking aria-describedby.
